Working Approach
Reliable data starts with disciplined engineering.

I approach data work with the same discipline required in production environments: understand the source, make transformations traceable, validate what matters, and deliver datasets people can trust.

Trace where data comes from, how it is structured, and what the business needs from it.

RETAIL CUSTOMER & SALES ANALYTICS
FEATURED

B.Laban Retail Analytics

An end-to-end retail data engineering and analytics platform built around B.Laban transaction data from Egypt, UAE, and KSA, simulating a dessert and food-service business.

5 Gold datasets6,952 validated transactions8 tests passed
Objective

Turn raw retail transactions into trusted datasets for branch, product, customer, ordering-channel, daily-sales, and operational performance analysis.

Engineering approach

Implemented Raw → Bronze → Silver → Gold using PySpark, Delta Lake, and Microsoft Fabric, with parallel Databricks implementation. Applied cleaning, enrichment, transaction validation, business rules, SQL checks, and Pytest coverage.

Deliverable

Five Gold analytical datasets and Power BI reporting assets. On the 7,000-row training dataset, 6,952 transactions passed validation and 48 were flagged; all 8 project tests passed. Reported revenue: 5,093,400.76; average order value: 732.65.

PythonPySparkMicrosoft FabricDatabricksDelta LakeSQLPower BIPytestView on GitHub ↗

RETAIL SUPPLY CHAIN & INVENTORY
FEATURED

RetailFlow

An end-to-end retail supply-chain pipeline that models inventory, purchase orders, supplier reliability, and warehouse fulfillment using a reproducible synthetic dataset.

55 automated tests2,638 fact/dimension rowsZero orphaned facts
Objective

Analyze stockout and reorder risk, supplier lead-time reliability, warehouse capacity, and purchase-order fulfillment across multiple facilities.

Engineering approach

Built a Raw–Bronze–Silver flow with immutable CSV ingestion, SHA-256 audit manifests, schema and business-rule contracts, deterministic deduplication, transformation metrics, and quarantine handling. Loaded PostgreSQL staging and analytical schemas through transactional, idempotent upserts.

Deliverable

A PostgreSQL Star Schema with inventory-snapshot and purchase-order-fulfillment facts plus date, supplier, warehouse, and product dimensions. The reference dataset reconciles 3,369 staging rows and 2,638 fact/dimension rows with zero orphaned facts or duplicate business keys; 55 automated tests pass.

PythonPostgreSQLDockerMedallion ArchitectureData QualityStar SchemaView on GitHub ↗

WEB DATA EXTRACTION & ANALYTICS

Real Estate Data Platform

An end-to-end platform built around PropertyFinder sale and rental listings, taking scraped property data through validation and SQL-based business analysis.

5 analytical SQL views50 listings validatedZero duplicates
Objective

Convert raw property listings into structured datasets that support pricing, location, bedroom, and rental-versus-sale analysis.

Engineering approach

Built Python scraping scripts with Requests and BeautifulSoup, transformed data using Pandas and NumPy, handled duplicates and missing or invalid values, calculated price per square meter, and validated records before loading to SQL Server.

Deliverable

PropertySale and PropertyRent tables, five analytical SQL views, and a dashboard. The documented validation covers 50 listings (25 sale and 25 rent) with zero duplicate rows; the dashboard supports pricing, area, bedroom, and location analysis.

BIG DATA & HEALTHCARE ANALYTICS

Hospital Admissions Data Pipeline

A Hadoop and Hive learning project that processes a synthetic hospital admissions dataset and turns it into queryable information and dashboard insights.

Hadoop + Hive26 sample admissionsSQL-based analysis
Objective

Demonstrate a data-processing workflow for cleaning, storing, and analyzing hospital admission records in a big-data environment.

Engineering approach

Deliverable
